claims.note: Title and meta description only; restates the article's own scope (requirement ledger recovered from the transcript). No numeric or model claim.

JetBrains Developer Ecosystem Survey 2026, 15,509 professional developers, May-July 2026. Re-read on the JetBrains Research blog: ~47% of code fully agent-written; 90% weekly / 68% daily agent use; cluster split 31% agentic (84% agent-written) and 23% manual (75% hand-written). All values match.

New Relic 2026 State of AI Coding (Hanover Research, 200 US decision-makers). Re-read on the press release: 94% rate AI code higher quality at review; 78% more incidents; 86% more senior time fixing; 74% at least 25% needs significant rework; 82% at least one production failure. All match.

Faros AI Engineering Report 2026 (22,000 developers, 4,000+ teams). Re-read on the Faros takeaways page: median time in review up 441.5%, time to first review up 156.6%, incidents per PR up 242.7%, PRs merged unreviewed up 31.3%. All four match verbatim.

Stanford SWE-chat via the arXiv 2609.04681 synthesis: 44% of agent-produced code survived into commits and users pushed back in 44% of turns, over 6,000 real coding-agent sessions. Confirmed in the synthesis full text.
